topic: Testing a person's vertical jump and reach against life-size cutouts of NBA players to show how hard it is to block shots.

hook.first_words: This shows just how difficult it is to block basketball players.
hook.first_frame: A man running towards a wall with life-size cutouts of NBA players including Victor Wembanyama.
hook.on_screen_text_0_3s: THIS SHOWS JUST HOW DIFFICULT IT IS TO BLOCK BASKETBALL PLAYERS

shots.shows: A man running and jumping to try to block a cutout basketball player.
The man running at a lineup of different player cutouts trying to reach higher basketball targets.

ending.last_frame: The man walking away after failing to reach Wembanyama's cutout basketball.

script: This shows just how difficult it is to block basketball players. It starts with free throws, where getting a hand near the ball is pretty easy. But once you try contesting shots from some of the best players in the world, everything changes. And in a real game, you obviously won't get this much time to load up and jump, even with a running start. This guy still couldn't block Wemby's shot.
retention_tricks: pacing from easier to harder challenges
visual scale with NBA player cutouts
what_makes_it_work: Clear physical comparison against famous athletes
Engaging narrative escalation from easy to impossible
Dynamic camera tracking the jumper's movement
